decisions.reason: The check-in mobile app was launched just before COVID crippled aviation, so its future is uncertain, but the 2022 travel recovery and demand for touchless processing give a reason to keep it.
PassBoard is the firm's flagship passenger processing technology and fits its core aviation security business, so the firm is likely to keep it as airports reopen.
Self-service check-in fits the post-pandemic push for contactless passenger flows, though weak uptake during the 2020-2021 aviation downturn makes it somewhat vulnerable.
